microwait.definition:
Consequence of the lunchtime rush for the microwave in corporate settings.
> "I'm going to eat lunch early today, to avoid the microwait."

microwatt.translation: n. [物]微瓦(特),百万分之一瓦(特)(功率单位, 符号为μW或μw)

microwave.definition:
n. a short electromagnetic wave (longer than infrared but shorter than radio waves); used for radar and microwave ovens and for transmitting telephone, facsimile, video and data
n. kitchen appliance that cooks food by passing an electromagnetic wave through it; heat results from the absorption of energy by the water molecules in the food
v. cook or heat in a microwave oven

microwave absorbing coating.translation: [化] (雷达)吸波涂层; 微波吸收涂层

microwave minute.definition:
When time slows down while waiting for you food to heat in the microwave. Known side effects are increased hunger, slowing of all the clocks in your house and walking around aimlessly trying to kill time. The microwave minute has the ability to slow time turning one minute into what feels lime an hour.
> Kus(9:00 pm): dude when are you gunna get here??
> Ryan(9:00 pm): I'll be there in a microwave minute.
> Kus(9:00 pm): aight g. Ill see you at 10:00!
